column1: Queen loss fails to elicit physiological and transcriptional responses in workers of the invasive garden ant Lasius neglectus
The genome assembly and annotations used for L. neglectus have been generated as part of the Global Ant Genomics Alliance (GAGA) project (Vizueta et al. 2025)
column2: these can be accessed in https://doi.org/10.17894/ucph.79f0417a-4e15-44de-91db-3f150e59a5fc and the genome data is also accessible in NCBI (GCA_048542085.1 under BioProject PRJNA1172379)
